rules: Resolve the target module by course slug plus module slug; never hardcode generated module UUIDs in a future migration.
Require exactly one target module and assert sequence 2 and the target lesson slug are unused before any insert.
Insert the lesson initially with is_published=false, then attach reviewed sources and six terms only after a separate explicit database-write decision.
Do not create user progress, mastery, Error Bank, review or audio rows as part of curriculum publication.
Run authored-content, source and application regression checks before any separate is_published=true decision.
Recheck current-sensitive official sources at publication time, especially Irish payroll guidance.
Never set a P1 lesson is_published=true until interactivePublicationGate is fully satisfied for that exact lesson identity.
English P1 must never fall back to the current Golden Lesson identity or reference when resolving Professor persistence or teaching context.

verifiedOffline: Exact P1 lesson identity, reviewed slug, authenticated track and isPublished=true are required before a server-authored reference is accepted.
Professor teacher/evaluator candidate metadata share the same P1-specific reference and exclude browser drafts, local quiz answers and hint state.
English P1 candidate persistence uses its own generated lesson identity and never the current English Golden Lesson identity.
The existing start_professor_session_atomic budget/start contract is exercised only after the exact P1 reference gate; denied budget stops before any provider-like envelope.
P1 Premium Audio candidate verifies exact ID/slug/track/content version, versioned cache, global/premium budget, protected Professor exposure and claim-before-provider ordering.
stillRequiredBeforeIsPublishedTrue: Promote the reviewed P1 reference resolver into a production server module and integrate it into the feature API with executable mocked-handler regressions.
Integrate exact P1 Premium Audio provider mounting only after its reviewed Supabase budget/dedup/reconciliation dependencies are deployed and verified.
Publish the exact P1 database row first as is_published=false and re-run the identity/source gates against the generated lesson ID.
Run browser acceptance proving that the published P1 opens the same written identity while Audio/Professor remain blocked until the exact provider gate is enabled.
Make is_published=true a separate explicit decision after the runtime/deployment evidence above.
interactivePublicationGate.currentClientBoundary: The dynamic read-only catalog is integrated and only allowlists reviewed runtime content. P1 written self-study may render for an allowlisted published row, but Audio and Professor are not mounted until the runtime/provider gate is separately satisfied.
interactivePublicationGate.notAuthorization: Passing the offline contract tests is not authorization to write Supabase data, deploy Edge/server changes, enable paid providers or publish a P1 lesson.

publicationDecision: Explicit and separate. This plan is not authorization to write to Supabase, deploy runtime/Edge changes, enable paid providers or publish the lessons.
